metadata.description: Pairwise co-occurrence matrix for additive signals — detect double-counting
metadata.status: PROVISIONAL — uses physical overlap estimates. Run with signal_results for empirical values.

recommendation: Pairs with physical_overlap >= 0.5 (2 pairs) require monitoring during initial deployment. If jaccard_similarity exceeds 0.5 in live data, consider merging or dropping the less predictive signal.
critical_pair: pressure_tendency_gust_front ↔ am_wind_shift_ramp (physical_overlap=0.6): Both detect wind shifts from frontal passages. If co-occurrence > 0.5, drop am_wind_shift_ramp in favor of pressure_tendency_gust_front which has more predictive specificity.
